summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Multi-Agent RAG (Google ADK + Qdrant Hybrid + Emergent gpt-5.4). Wrote pytest suite covering /api/status, /api/ingest idempotency, /api/chat (4 scenarios: grounded doc question, incident CrashLoopBackOff with Suggested Resolution, source filter=servicenow, live open-incident INC0012999), and /api/history. All 7 tests pass. Frontend Playwright E2E validates header (indexed=19, emergent, gpt-5.4), 5 sample-query chips, 4 source filter buttons, chat flow producing assistant-message with 5 citation-links, suggested-resolution-card, view-trace-button, agent-trace-panel Pipeline + Events tabs, ingestion-status-dashboard with 3 source cards and run-ingest-button.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend pipeline is well-structured (SequentialAgent -> ParallelAgent(document, incident, search) -> rerank/validate -> response). Stages/events schema is consistent and observable.
Ingest endpoint is properly idempotent via content-hash dedup (verified: 2nd call returns skipped=8, ingested=0).
Consider adding a lightweight readiness endpoint distinct from /api/status for K8s probes (currently /api/status is heavy-ish because it aggregates counts).
Chat request latency is 7-20s (LLM 6-step agent graph). Frontend correctly disables send button while loading; consider optimistic 'thinking' indicator (already present via UI, verified).
seed_data_creation: None. App auto-ingests mock data at startup (confluence=3/9, worddoc=2/7, servicenow=3/3 -> 19 chunks).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_api_endpoints.py works end-to-end (~37s). Note: /api/ingest response schema uses top-level ingested/skipped/chunks plus per-source under 'sources' (NOT 'results'). Stages array uses 'stage' key (not 'name'). Chat takes 7-20s so use timeout>=60s. Live-lookup tool name is 'lookup_open_incident'.
